a: A trace is a tree of spans representing one request across services.
A span is a timed operation with attributes, events, and status.
Context propagation carries trace IDs across process boundaries via headers.
traceparent/tracestate headers standardize distributed tracing context.
Exporters send telemetry to backends like Jaeger, Tempo, or cloud APM.
Auto-instrumentation hooks common libraries; manual spans add business context.
Baggage propagates key-value application data alongside the trace context.
Head/tail sampling control which traces are kept to manage cost.
Exemplars link metric data points to example traces.
OTel semantic conventions standardize attribute names (http.method, etc.).
